title: quick accent inserts `」` as `「` in the wechat desktop app
author: brauljo

judgment.rationale: The report contains an exact character mismatch and a diagnostic attachment, but not the Quick Accent activation gesture, selected language/layout, WeChat version, or a control application result needed to isolate an app-specific text-input transformation.
evidence: The reporter says selecting or typing 」 through Quick Accent produces 「 only in WeChat Desktop.
A public bug-report ZIP is attached.
Power Accent uses a low-level keyboard listener and supports excluding foreground applications.
There are no follow-up comments or linked fix attempts.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact gesture and an app comparison that can identify whether the issue is in Quick Accent output or WeChat input handling.

fix_assessment.rationale: No code fix can be responsibly targeted until the selection path, keyboard layout, and application-specific scope are confirmed.

issue_context.summary: Quick Accent appears to produce the opening corner bracket instead of the requested closing bracket when the destination application is WeChat Desktop.
known_information: The issue identifies Quick Accent, WeChat Desktop, and the two distinct Unicode characters.
The report is from PowerToys 0.100.2 and includes a public diagnostic archive.
No discussion supplies activation, language, or comparison details.
inferences: The destination application or active input method may be transforming the text, but Quick Accent emission is not ruled out.
issue_context.analysis: An exact character pair is valuable, but the report has no discriminator between an output-selection defect and an application/IME compatibility path. A small application comparison is more relevant than requesting another generic log.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and discussion.
Searched live issue titles for a directly matching WeChat bracket report; no direct duplicate was found.

information_gaps.information: The Quick Accent activation and selection steps, active Windows keyboard layout/IME, WeChat Desktop version, and results in Notepad plus one other application.
information_gaps.why_needed: These observations identify whether the incorrect character is selected by PowerToys or changed only by the destination application's input path.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Record the exact key sequence and selected candidate, then paste or enter the same candidate in WeChat Desktop, Notepad, and one additional application without changing the active input language.

comment.body: Thank you for identifying the exact bracket pair and attaching a report. To determine whether Quick Accent selects the wrong character or WeChat changes it through its input path, please provide the exact activation and selection keys, active Windows keyboard layout/IME, and WeChat Desktop version. Please also repeat the same selection in Notepad and one other application, without changing the input language, and share which applications produce 」 versus 「.
